title: account standup bulletboard - daily prep
content:
Morning quickboard (scratchpad) - for Orchard Health weekly cadence and a few other accounts.

Top focus today:
- Renewal nudges: Orchard Health (renewal window: 2026-06-10). Need updated forecast from finance by Fri.
  - Action: send one-line calendar invite to finance + product to lock in discount conversation (30m).
- Quarterly review prep (Orchard Health): pull token usage, latency trends, and top error classes for the last 90 days.
  - Metrics to pull: avg P95 latency per route, token breakdown (prompt/completion), top 5 error codes.
  - Reminder: include Optimize suggestions applied last month and cost-savings realized (~12% drop).
- Support follow-ups: ticket CS-3421 (embedding mismatch) — engineer says low-priority patch deployed to staging. Confirm ETA for prod deploy.

Meeting snippets / talking points (for review doc):
1) What we shipped: moved them to dedicated capacity on 2026-03-28, autoscale policy tuned (burst cap enabled).
2) Observed wins: 1) predictability for peak window (8–10am ET), 2) 12% cost improvement after caching config.
3) Risks: occasional KV-cache cold starts during midnight batch jobs — propose schedule shift or pre-warm job.
4) Ask: sign-up for 1-yr reserved capacity discount before 2026-06-10 to secure price.

Quick TODOs (tick when done):
- [ ] Export token usage CSV for Orchard Health (last 90 days) — query: analytics/export/usage?acct=orchard (Jira note).
- [ ] Draft 1-pager renewal value props (security + dedicated SLA) and share with AE (Lina).
- [ ] Ping infra eng for CS-3421 prod deploy ETA (Slack #cs-orchard).
- [ ] Add two customer quotes from success survey to slides (positive latency callouts).

Support and escalation notes:
- If prod deploy slips >3 business days: escalate to SRE on-call (pager: sres-oncall) and offer temporary routing to hosted API as fallback.
- Log for support triage: attach sample payload (anonymized) and indicate model/version pinned (gpt-4o-infer-v2-q4).

Personal triage list (not for doc):
- Grab quick screenshot of Console > Rollouts > Orchard Health canary metrics (for slide 3).
- Write 3 bullets for "how Redwood saved ops time" (customer quote + metric).

Links & references (quick):
- Slack thread: https://redwood.slack.com/archives/C03CSH-ORCHARD/p1623456789000000
- Jira: CS-3421, CS-3587 (renewal playbooks)
- Confluence (draft review): https://confluence.redwood.com/display/CS/Orchard+Quarterly+Review+Draft

Notes to self:
- Keep bullets short in deck — exec prefers 4 slides max + appendix.
- If finance asks for ARR math, use committed throughput * unit price in dedicated plan (attach calc tab).
